infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PatchLab uses your camera so you can photograph your plants and send photos in Messenger.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PatchLab accesses your photos so you can attach pictures to your grows, seed listings and messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PatchLab can save photos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PatchLab uses your microphone to record voice messages in Messenger.
